finalText:
**Drafted 4.2.0 in [CHANGELOG.md:3](CHANGELOG.md:3).** 380 commits, about 20 matter.

Four break users. Expired tokens return `401`, not `403`. The `v1` export route is gone. Internal error types no longer re-export from `core`, `db`, `auth`, `jobs`, `billing`. Latency histogram units changed, so dashboards shift.

One feature: webhook retries with backoff. Eight real fixes, biggest being request bodies no longer hitting logs.

Two calls to check. I added a `Performance` heading, which is a fourth section. And docs kept bumping the minimum Node version but I found no `engines` change, so I left it out.
